nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## How to use - tested on RTX 3060 12 GB

**The inputs start bypassed (purple), so Text to image runs right away.** For **Edit (your images)**, un-bypass (select + Ctrl+B) Image 1 (and 2, 3 if you use them) and load your files. **Keep every input you are not using bypassed**: ComfyUI checks the file of every active loader before a run.

| Mode | Uses | RTX 3060 |
|---|---|---|
| Text to image | prompt | 1 MP: 16 s · 2K: 1:11 |
| Edit (your images) | Image 1 (+ 2, 3 optional) | 1 MP: 34 s (1 image) · 56 s (2 images) |

If you pick Edit and Image 1 is still bypassed, the run stops at the "Needs Image 1" node instead of quietly making a text-to-image.

**Transparent background** puts the model card's phrase "RGBA, 4-channel, transparent background." in front of your prompt. Ming always outputs RGBA, and Save Image keeps the alpha channel (PNG).
**Megapixels**: 4 = 2048x2048 (best quality per the model card), 1 = 1024x1024 (faster). Edit uses Image 1's own shape at this size; images 2 and 3 are resized to Image 1 by the encoder.
**Prompt**: write the layout section by section and put every word you want rendered in quotes. The official template's prompt enhancer (Qwen3.8 27B, 17.3 GB more) is left out: your prompt goes in exactly as typed.
12 steps, euler (text to image) / LCM (edit), simple scheduler, no negative prompt, no CFG: the official templates' settings.

Double-click the node to see every step. **Colours inside the node:** 🟦 load models · 🟩 your input (pose, face, frames) · 🟪 prompt + conditioning · 🟧 sampling · 🟨 decode + video · ⬛ settings + switches · 🟦‍ cyan = extras (side by side)

nodes.title: Downloads
widgets_values:
## Downloads - put each file in the ComfyUI folder shown

Click a file name to download it. Put it in the folder shown (inside `ComfyUI/models/`).

**[Comfy-Org/Ming-Image](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ming-Image)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| all modes | `diffusion_models/` | [ming_image_0.1_design_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ming-Image/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ming_image_0.1_design_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 6.2 GB |
| all modes (32 GB RAM) | `text_encoders/` | [ming_image_0.1_ling_mini_2.0_w4a8.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ming-Image/resolve/main/text_encoders/ming_image_0.1_ling_mini_2.0_w4a8.safetensors) | 12.8 GB |
| all modes | `vae/` | [ming_image_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ming-Image/resolve/main/vae/ming_image_vae_bf16.safetensors) | 0.3 GB |

_Tested on: RTX 3060 12 GB · 32 GB RAM · ComfyUI 0.39.2._

The official templates use the int8 text encoder (`ming_image_0.1_ling_mini_2.0_int8_convrot`, 19.5 GB); it works too, pick it in the Text encoder field. No custom nodes: core ComfyUI **0.39 or newer** (Ming Image support). Ming Image 0.1 Design: MIT license.
